# At the core of what works

[
Get to know Lhoist
][4]
Get to know Lhoist

## At Lhoist, we provide lime, dolime, and mineral-based solutions that drive progress worldwide.

We partner with our customers and we deliver critical solutions across various [industries][5]. From
treating [drinking water][6] and [stabilizing soils][7] to [reducing emissions][8] and supporting
demanding industrial processes, our [products][9] support demanding operations that must perform
consistently.  

[
Learn more about us
][10]
[Expert in action_one man with a screen]

## Partner with Lhoist

We combine deep operational [expertise][11] with dependable, high‑performing solutions that perform
where it matters - in the real‑world conditions our customers face every day. Our products are
engineered to meet the specific demands of critical operations and applications. Beyond supply, we
also provide hands‑on [technical support][12] and reliable logistics services to help optimize
performance and efficiency.

[
Explore our solutions
][13]

## Learn more about the industries we support

[Expert at work _US]

## Join Lhoist to create lasting impact

At Lhoist, you [join teams][14] who take responsibility for keeping critical operations running, day
after day. Across our many roles, you will have the opportunity to grow your skills, solve real
challenges on the ground, and contribute to solutions that support industries and communities over
the long term. Step in and help build the reliability our future depends on.

[
Start your journey with us
][15]

## Lhoist around the world

With a presence in 20+ countries with 130+ sites, we are close to our customers, delivering
reliability and expertise. 

[
See where we operate
][16]

## Our markets (sales by market)

32% Sales by market doughnut chart. Steel, 32 percent. Currently selected.

Pulp and Paper Non-ferrous metallurgical processing
At the core of what works.  

## Who we are

Our [lime][17], [dolime][18], and mineral solutions enable clean [water][19], stable soils,
[steel][20] under pressure, and renewable energy - where reliability matters every single day. 
Founded in 1889 and still family-owned, we combine long-term vision with hands-on expertise to meet
evolving needs. 
With 6,400+ people across 20+ countries, 130+ sites, and 80+ country sales reach, we stay close to
customers to secure supply and ensure continuity when it counts. 
Guided by respect, integrity, and courage, we work on site with operators, anticipating issues,
adapting to conditions, and creating lasting value through strong partnerships. Our teams deliver
the insight and support that keep performance steady and consistently.

### Perceived by the eye for the delight of the soul

At the time Hans Hoffman was expressing his visions through his art, the pioneers of Mason Color^{®}
were creating their vision of color to the ceramists of the world. Five generations of experience
and dedication has gone into the development and manufacturing of our ceramic stains.

We take great care and pride into reproducing your color needs to the highest standards. Mason
Color^{®} has been a name you’ve grown to know and trust since 1842 and can continue to trust for
generations to come. Let us help you turn your vision into work of art.

We mine, process and sell industrial minerals at locations worldwide, focused primarily on silica,

## Who we are

### 
### About Sibelco

Founded in 1872, we have grown into a multinational business with operations in 31 countries and an
extensive multi-mineral portfolio. We work across a broad range of industries, anticipating and
meeting our customers’ changing needs with innovative solutions that combine high-specification
materials and dedicated technical support.

Everything we do is guided by our purpose:* material solutions advancing life*. Our products help to
build homes, cities and vehicles; to support the supply of renewable energy, food and clean water;
to create technologies such as smartphone display screens, printed circuit boards and
semiconductors.

We do this within a robust sustainability framework, always balancing economic performance with
environmental stewardship and social responsibility.

[Reaching Real Circularity]

### Reaching Real Circularity

"At Ball, we strive to create the perfect circle for our packaging products so that the materials
can be used over and over. We are striving toward our 2030 commitments."
 
* Align the industry to achieve a 90% global recycling rate for aluminum beverage cans, bottles and
  cups (2030).
* Work together with our supply chain partners to achieve an 85% average recycled content in the
  aluminum used to produce beverage cans, bottles and cups in the regions where we operate (2030).
* Launch second generation of ReAl® aerosol container technology with 75% recycled content (2030).

### Reaching Real Circularity

"At Ball, we strive to create the perfect circle for our packaging products so that the materials
can be used over and over. We are striving toward our 2030 commitments."
 
* Align the industry to achieve a 90% global recycling rate for aluminum beverage cans, bottles and
  cups (2030).
* Work together with our supply chain partners to achieve an 85% average recycled content in the
  aluminum used to produce beverage cans, bottles and cups in the regions where we operate (2030).
* Launch second generation of ReAl® aerosol container technology with 75% recycled content (2030).

## Welcome to Bikaner Clay Industries

We are well know Manufacturers and Producers of a broad range of Washed Ball Clay, Washed China
Clay, etc.

[Know More][9]

## Bikaner Clay Industries

#### Est 1988

### Our Story

BCI has over 2 generations of in-house experience, with a strong focus on growing the clay industry
in India and be at par with global standards Historically, BCI has business footprint over various
different industries stretching from manufacturing 'woolen-yarns' for hand knitted carpets to food
grains assorting to clays manufacturing. It has even been holders of Guiness book of records for
finest hand knitted carpets.
* Close to 4 Decades of Experience
* Exceptional Work Quality
* Global Industry Standards

## WHY CLEVELAND?

Cleveland, OH is a city at the heart of America’s industrial renaissance and a $266B manufacturing
powerhouse. Its strategic location makes it the perfect meeting point for the entire technical
ceramics ecosystem, connecting suppliers, engineers, buyers, and end-users in one highly accessible
hub.

[FIND OUT MORE][38]
 
 
 

**IN PARTNERSHIP WITH**

[ [Founding Partners and Organizations supporting Ceramics Expo 2026] ][39]
 
 
 

## CHECK OUT THE 2026 AGENDA

Packed with insightful content, this year’s expertly curated agenda is designed to **expand your
knowledge and unlock the potential of technical ceramics **across multiple industries, driving
product advancements and innovation. 

[2026 AGENDA][40]


**"Every time I come I find multiple vendors who are making materials or a new method of doing
something that triggers an application that is relevant to the work I'm doing. It's so important for
ceramic materials engineers to attend the show."**

**James Weigner, Lockheed Martin**

** **

[THE INNOVATION HUB]

**THE INNOVATION HUB**

Uniting startups, academia, and industry leaders to spark innovation, highlight groundbreaking
technologies, and shape the future of materials science.

[FIND OUT MORE][41]

## The Clay Consulting Solution: Serving the Federal Healthcare Ecosystem

Clay Consulting serves the federal healthcare ecosystem from the Departments of Defense, Labor, and
Justice right on down to state-level agencies.

Government agencies and federal healthcare systems are undergoing radical transformation in the name
of modernization, efficiency, and operational improvements.

Veterans, reservists, active duty members of our armed services deserve high quality services. Clay
Consulting's services, locations, and professionals are uniquely qualified to serve this critical
community.

Our medical panel includes licensed, board-certified professionals in every specialty and our
professionals ensure that our services and portals comply with regulations.

Interested in partnering with Clay Consulting?

[Contact us][28] and let us know what services you need. We are agile and confident that we can
design a program to bring all your contracts in on time.

[ Contact Us ][29]
[General Medicine Clay Consulting]

### Occupational and Behavioral Health

We provide comprehensive examinations from highly trained licensed professionals. The full scope of
occupational health and ancillary services are offered at most locations.

[person with disability and german shepard outside setting-1]

### Medical Disability Examinations

Our medical examiners review medical records, conduct a physical exam if needed, and potentially ask
questions about symptoms to determine eligibility for benefits.

[Audiology Clay Consulting]

### Audiology

Our offices are equipped with advanced audiological equipment to meet the unique types of hearing
loss and neurological issues resulting from active duty and battlefield engagement.

Clay Consulting serves the federal healthcare ecosystem from the Departments of Defense, Labor, and
Justice right on down to state-level agencies.

Government agencies and federal healthcare systems are undergoing radical transformation in the name
of modernization, efficiency, and operational improvements.

Veterans, reservists, active duty members of our armed services deserve high quality services. Clay
Consulting's services, locations, and professionals are uniquely qualified to serve this critical
community.

Our medical panel includes licensed, board-certified professionals in every specialty and our
professionals ensure that our services and portals comply with regulations.

Independent Clay experts for teams that need clean data, reliable workflows, and GTM systems that
work in production.

The real risk

## Clay is powerful. Bad Clay workflows are expensive.

Most teams do not fail because Clay is weak. They fail because the workflow architecture is unclear,
the enrichment logic is messy, the CRM sync is risky, or nobody owns QA.

▦

### Messy tables nobody understands

Columns multiply, logic gets buried, and the team stops trusting the workflow.

◌

### Expensive enrichment and action usage

Waterfalls, retries, and AI steps quietly become harder to price and control.

⛓

### Fragile automations and broken dependencies

One changed column or API response can break the whole GTM motion.

◆

### Risky CRM updates

Production records need guardrails, validation, and clear ownership before sync.

How we help

## Get expert help at the stage you are actually in.

Choose a focused engagement for your current reality: audit, build, rescue, or white-label delivery.

Audit

### Clay Workflow Audit

For teams already using Clay but unsure whether the setup is reliable, scalable, or cost-efficient.
* Workflow review
* Enrichment logic review
* Cost and action risk review
* CRM sync risk review
* Failure points and cleanup plan

Build

### Clay Build Sprint

For teams that know what they want and need a senior builder to ship it.
* ICP/list setup
* Enrichment waterfalls
* AI research prompts
* Scoring logic
* CRM/sequencer export
* QA documentation

Repair

### Clay Rescue Sprint

For teams whose Clay setup is broken, messy, too expensive, or too fragile.
* Workflow restructuring
* Broken column and dependency cleanup
* Prompt and formula fixes
* Guardrails and validation
* Cleaner handoff documentation

Partner

### White-Label Clay Expert Support

For agencies that sell outbound, RevOps, recruiting, or GTM automation but need expert Clay delivery
in the background.
* Client builds
* Backend troubleshooting
* Workflow QA
* White-label documentation
* Retained expert capacity

Why production quality matters

## Built for production GTM, not sandbox experiments.

Clay workflows touch real leads, real customer records, real campaigns, and sometimes your CRM. That
means the work needs more than clever prompts. It needs architecture, QA, documentation, and an
understanding of GTM operations.

✓We design workflows around business outcomes, not just interesting enrichments.
✓We document the logic so your team can maintain it.
✓We think about cost, failure modes, and data safety.
✓We understand outbound, CRM enrichment, recruiting, and agency delivery.
✓We can work as a strategic advisor, implementation partner, or white-label backend team.

Use cases

CRM enrichment and cleanup Account scoring Lead sourcing Intent-based outbound AI-powered
personalization Recruiting agency workflows Job-change and hiring-trigger workflows Website visitor
enrichment Smartlead / Instantly campaign exports HubSpot / Salesforce enrichment syncs Agency
client delivery systems Workflow QA and documentation

Process

## A simple, low-risk process

No vague build-and-pray engagement. We diagnose, design, implement, and hand off the system clearly.

1

### Diagnose

We understand your GTM motion, current Clay setup, data sources, goals, and risks.

2

### Design

We map the workflow before building: inputs, enrichment logic, scoring, outputs, QA checks, and
ownership.

3

### Build or Repair

We implement the workflow, clean up dependencies, add guardrails, and test edge cases.

4

### Handoff

You get documentation, review notes, and a clear explanation of how the system works.

05 **CRM / Sequencer** HubSpot, Salesforce, Smartlead, Instantly

The real risk

## Clay is powerful. Bad Clay workflows are expensive.

Most teams do not fail because Clay is weak. They fail because the workflow architecture is unclear,
the enrichment logic is messy, the CRM sync is risky, or nobody owns QA.

▦

### Messy tables nobody understands

Columns multiply, logic gets buried, and the team stops trusting the workflow.

◌

### Expensive enrichment and action usage

Waterfalls, retries, and AI steps quietly become harder to price and control.

⛓

### Fragile automations and broken dependencies

One changed column or API response can break the whole GTM motion.

◆

### Risky CRM updates

Production records need guardrails, validation, and clear ownership before sync.

✦

### Personalization that does not convert

Impressive research is not useful unless it improves relevance and response quality.

How we help

## Get expert help at the stage you are actually in.

Choose a focused engagement for your current reality: audit, build, rescue, or white-label delivery.

Audit

### Clay Workflow Audit

For teams already using Clay but unsure whether the setup is reliable, scalable, or cost-efficient.
* Workflow review
* Enrichment logic review
* Cost and action risk review
* CRM sync risk review
* Failure points and cleanup plan

Build

### Clay Build Sprint

For teams that know what they want and need a senior builder to ship it.
* ICP/list setup
* Enrichment waterfalls
* AI research prompts
* Scoring logic
* CRM/sequencer export
* QA documentation

Repair

### Clay Rescue Sprint

For teams whose Clay setup is broken, messy, too expensive, or too fragile.
* Workflow restructuring
* Broken column and dependency cleanup
* Prompt and formula fixes
* Guardrails and validation
* Cleaner handoff documentation

Partner

### White-Label Clay Expert Support

For agencies that sell outbound, RevOps, recruiting, or GTM automation but need expert Clay delivery
in the background.
* Client builds
* Backend troubleshooting
* Workflow QA
* White-label documentation
* Retained expert capacity

Why production quality matters

## Built for production GTM, not sandbox experiments.

Clay workflows touch real leads, real customer records, real campaigns, and sometimes your CRM. That
means the work needs more than clever prompts. It needs architecture, QA, documentation, and an
understanding of GTM operations.

✓We design workflows around business outcomes, not just interesting enrichments.
✓We document the logic so your team can maintain it.
✓We think about cost, failure modes, and data safety.
✓We understand outbound, CRM enrichment, recruiting, and agency delivery.
✓We can work as a strategic advisor, implementation partner, or white-label backend team.

Use cases

## Common Clay workflows we help with

CRM enrichment and cleanup Account scoring Lead sourcing Intent-based outbound AI-powered
personalization Recruiting agency workflows Job-change and hiring-trigger workflows Website visitor
enrichment Smartlead / Instantly campaign exports HubSpot / Salesforce enrichment syncs Agency
client delivery systems Workflow QA and documentation

Process

## A simple, low-risk process

No vague build-and-pray engagement. We diagnose, design, implement, and hand off the system clearly.

1

### Diagnose

We understand your GTM motion, current Clay setup, data sources, goals, and risks.

2

### Design

We map the workflow before building: inputs, enrichment logic, scoring, outputs, QA checks, and
ownership.

3

### Build or Repair

We implement the workflow, clean up dependencies, add guardrails, and test edge cases.

4

### Handoff

You get documentation, review notes, and a clear explanation of how the system works.

Start here

## Not sure what your Clay setup needs?

Start with a Clay Workflow Audit. We will review your current setup and tell you what is working,
what is risky, what is wasting money, and what should be rebuilt.

[Book an Audit][10]

The goal is not just to get columns running. The goal is a Clay workflow your GTM team can trust,

# Welcome to Claypro Australia

We specialise in the fine grinding of Axedale Ballclay, a clay renowned for its plasticity that has
been used in pottery, ceramics and refractories for nearly 100 years. The result is a 75 micron
product which is packed in 20kg paper sacks/bags, 1200kg bulk bags or into a bulk pressure tanker
for delivery to silo.

Our Claypro product serves a variety of purposes. Claypro can be used in increasing the plasticity
and workability of renders and concrete, increasing the fire rating of plasterboard or as a
filler/binder in barbecue briquettes. Claypro can also be used as a carrier dust for insecticides.

Claypro was first introduced to the pavement materials market in 2004 due to VicRoads tightening its
specification with regard to the plasticity index (PI) in Class 1 Pavement Materials.

The Plasticity Index is an important property in flexible pavement materials, it indicates the range
of moisture contents over which the fine particles (<0.45mm) behaves plastically. A PI that is two
high will cause issues with pavement stability, particularly under dynamic loads. Whilst a PI that
is too low will result in a pavement material that lacks cohesiveness and may result in unravelling
and/or uncompacting of that particular coarse.

The majority of natural pavement materials sourced within Victoria are unable to meet VicRoads PI
requirements, whilst also meeting requirements for swell, grading envelopes and CBR. Claypro is a
solution that when mixed into Class 1 pavement material at low percentages has demonstrated to have
positive effects on the PI and permeability properties, whilst having minimal effect on the swell,
grading envelope and CBR of such materials. This positive affect can be attributed to ClayPro’s
product having a very high PI and a very small particle size.

─────

Claypro is an Australian clay supplier company involved in processing and packaging various clays
for the ceramic, pottery, refractory and industrial filler markets.

Whatever your application needs we will be pleased to discuss your requirements. Please visit [our

# Welcome to Claypro Australia

We specialise in the fine grinding of Axedale Ballclay, a clay renowned for its plasticity that has
been used in pottery, ceramics and refractories for nearly 100 years. The result is a 75 micron
product which is packed in 20kg paper sacks/bags, 1200kg bulk bags or into a bulk pressure tanker
for delivery to silo.

Our Claypro product serves a variety of purposes. Claypro can be used in increasing the plasticity
and workability of renders and concrete, increasing the fire rating of plasterboard or as a
filler/binder in barbecue briquettes. Claypro can also be used as a carrier dust for insecticides.

Claypro was first introduced to the pavement materials market in 2004 due to VicRoads tightening its
specification with regard to the plasticity index (PI) in Class 1 Pavement Materials.

The Plasticity Index is an important property in flexible pavement materials, it indicates the range
of moisture contents over which the fine particles (<0.45mm) behaves plastically. A PI that is two
high will cause issues with pavement stability, particularly under dynamic loads. Whilst a PI that
is too low will result in a pavement material that lacks cohesiveness and may result in unravelling
and/or uncompacting of that particular coarse.

The majority of natural pavement materials sourced within Victoria are unable to meet VicRoads PI
requirements, whilst also meeting requirements for swell, grading envelopes and CBR. Claypro is a
solution that when mixed into Class 1 pavement material at low percentages has demonstrated to have
positive effects on the PI and permeability properties, whilst having minimal effect on the swell,
grading envelope and CBR of such materials. This positive affect can be attributed to ClayPro’s
product having a very high PI and a very small particle size.

─────

Claypro Australia offers various clays to suit different customers' needs such as pottery clay, ball
clay, ceramic clay and strawbale renderers' clay.

Claypro is an Australian clay supplier company involved in processing and packaging various clays
for the ceramic, pottery, refractory and industrial filler markets.

Whatever your application needs we will be pleased to discuss your requirements. Please visit [our
Contact page][14] for any enquiries you may have.

## ABOUT

C & L Minerals Sdn. Bhd. was set up primarily to operate, market and sell raw materials or minerals
such as stone quarry, sand mines, sea
sand, ball clay and tin ore. We are the preferred material supplier to Construction builders,
Concrete batching plants, Sand & Roof bricks manufacturers, precast concrete manufacturers and other
building materials companies. We serve clients in Wilayah Persekutuan KL, Selangor and Negeri
Sembilan surrounding areas. 


We started business with tin ore and mining sand in Bestari Jaya (formerly known as Batang
Berjuntai) and later expanded to producing ball clay for export more than 10 years ago. In 2009 till
present time, we reached greater heights to include operating quarries, sea sand and sand mines in
Selangor and Negeri Sembilan.

## ABOUT

C & L Minerals Sdn. Bhd. was set up primarily to operate, market and sell raw materials or minerals
such as stone quarry, sand mines, sea
sand, ball clay and tin ore. We are the preferred material supplier to Construction builders,
Concrete batching plants, Sand & Roof bricks manufacturers, precast concrete manufacturers and other
building materials companies. We serve clients in Wilayah Persekutuan KL, Selangor and Negeri
Sembilan surrounding areas. 


We started business with tin ore and mining sand in Bestari Jaya (formerly known as Batang
Berjuntai) and later expanded to producing ball clay for export more than 10 years ago. In 2009 till
present time, we reached greater heights to include operating quarries, sea sand and sand mines in
Selangor and Negeri Sembilan.

energy production and storage, transportation, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, food, agriculture and
ranching, ceramic and glass, and sports and recreation. LEARN MORE

mining industry supplies the necessary minerals to make modern life work. Yet most people remain
unaware of just how commonly minerals are used, down to the simplest pleasures.   LEARN MORE

About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

[ About Freshdi
Freshdi is a global B2B marketplace powered by AI.By integrating AI across the entire journey,
Freshdi enables suppliers and buyers worldwide to connect quickly, easily, and reliably - in just
only three steps: listing products, smart matching & trade connecting.
What makes Freshdi different?
Unlike traditional B2B platforms, Freshdi is built as an AI-driven marketplace, optimized for global
sourcing and export success in the digital age.
What documents are needed for the verified badge?
To earn the Verified Badge on Freshdi, submit one of the following: Business Registration
Certificate, Tax Registration Document, or Official Address Proof. Verification boosts your
credibility and attracts more buyer inquiries. [View more][1]
How can I improve my chances of finding buyers?
To enhance the efficiency of finding and connecting with buyers, list your products, complete
verification, send quotations, respond quickly to inquiries, and connect with buyers on the HOT and
NEW tab. Building global trade relationships takes consistent effort - we recommend committing at
least 4 months and investing in a Premium profile to stand out. [View more][2]
Are the buyers and suppliers listed here trustworthy?
Freshdi filters out suspicious profiles through verification services, but we are not a verification
agency. Users should still conduct independent checks and use trusted sources like embassies or
third-party agencies. Face-to-face meetings are highly recommended to reduce risks. [View more][3]
What are the benefits of the Premium Plan?
The Premium Plan helps you scale faster and connect with more serious buyers: stay on top of search
results, get fast access to inquiries, build trust with a detailed profile and product portfolio,
appear on the homepage and buyer emails, and stand out as a Premium Supplier. [View more][4]

# We Are Leading Industrial Minerals Manufacturer & Supplier.

We are Mine Owners and the leading producer and supplier of Talc, Calcium Carbonate (both GCC &
PCC), China Clay, Kaolin, Calcined Kaolin, Dolomite, Feldspar, Quartz, Bentonite, Roasted Bentonite,
Hydrated Lime, Quick Lime, Bleaching Clay, Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate, Aluminium Sulphate,
Sodium Silicate, Dicalcium Phosphate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Mg/Ca/Zn Stearate, Sodium Chloride, PVD
Salt, Paraffin Wax, Shea Butter, Petroleum Jelly and other non-metal industrial minerals. We cater
to a wide range of industries including Food, Pharma, Cosmetic, Home and Personal Care, Paint &
Coating, Ink, Adhesives, Plastic Compounding, Rubber, Ceramic, Feed, Agriculture and more. HTMC
Group is at the forefront of driving growth and innovation in the mineral sector as one of the Top
Manufacturers of Minerals in India.

][29]

## About
## HiTech Minerals and Chemicals Group

HTMC is engaged in manufacturing, processing, distributing, and exporting Natural minerals like
talc, Dolomite, Calcium carbonate, Feldspar, Calcite so on to varied industries such as Food Pharama
Automotive, Agriculture, Construction, Iron &Steel, Paints & Coating etc. As premier [**Mineral
Manufacturers in India**][30], HTMC Group specializes in procuring, processing, and supplying a
comprehensive array of industrial minerals. As one of the top industrial distribution companies in
India, we specialize in processing, manufacturing, and supplying a wide range of non-metallic
mineral products to meet the diverse needs of our clients.

We are the undisputed leading source of minerals and chemicals -
* 40+ years of experience
* Complete technical Compliance with certifications.
* US-DMF Registered Manufacturing Facility
* 3-In house internationally accredited Labs
* Global footprint in 39+ countries
* Purity of our minerals

Our mission is to become that one big player in a highly fragmented industry through increased
aggregation, catering to industry wide customers through JIT supply chains to optimise cost by
employing our considerable and cvolving technical, manufacturing and logistics capabilities. Our
vast network and strategic partnerships enable us to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique
needs of [Mineral Based Industry][31] across India.As a trusted bulk mineral supplier, HTMC Group
offers a wide range of minerals in large quantities. Our efficient supply chain ensures timely
delivery and competitive pricing for our clients.At HTMC Group, we take immense pride in being a
leading force in the Indian industrial mineral landscape. We transcend the limitations of simply
being mineral processors in India

ABOUT US

# Your Trusted Source for Top-Quality Industrial Minerals

Jay Ganesh Mineral Company was started in 2005 with a clear objective and ambition of becoming the
premier mineral entity in the market. As the largest manufacturer and supplier of premium quality
clay, we provide a wide variety of industrial uses for our clay products. Right from the
Semi-Plastic Clay to Ball Clay, White Clay, WBC Clay, China Clay and very fine Processed Clay,
Zirconium Silicate each of these minerals presents its finest characterization and uniformity.

It also deals with operations beyond clay by sourcing and supplying Indonesian Coal (the best type
of coal) and Lignite Coal. With five fully operational mines, our business guarantees sustainable
and reliable supply of the commodities demanded by our clients around the world.

## Kaushal Sales Corporation

Kaushal Sales Corporation is an established industrial minerals and raw materials supplier based in
Bikaner, Rajasthan. Specializing in the manufacturing and export of clay, sand, and gypsum-based
products, the company is a trusted resource for domestic and international construction,
manufacturing, and refractory sectors.

Established in 2005 under the leadership of Mr. Mukesh Agarwal, the company has grown into a
well-recognized name in the industrial minerals domain. Operating out of the Mukta Prasad Colony
area of Bikaner, Kaushal Sales Corporation serves a worldwide market, handling the extraction,
processing, and distribution of raw materials for various industrial applications.

**Quality Assurance and Infrastructure:**

Kaushal Sales Corporation focuses heavily on maintaining strict quality control. Their products are
sourced from premium raw materials and processed using modern technology and machinery. Operating
with a dedicated workforce of 20 to 50 employees, the company ensures that all products are
rigorously tested to meet industry-approved standards under expert supervision

**Market Reach:**

While headquartered in Bikaner, Rajasthan, the company has expanded its market reach globally. By
leveraging strong logistics and an expansive supply chain, they cater to a robust roster of
international and domestic clients, firmly establishing themselves as reliable exporters and
suppliers in the global trade sector.

LOVE THIS APP. Such a powerful tool and helps me both personally and professionally manage
relationships, check in with colleagues/friends, and stay updated on what people in my contacts are
up to. Would be much harder to do all of this without this app.

Ok, absolutely love this because why was I trying to build a similar solution for myself using
Trello and Notion and it was just not giving. Mesh however does GIVE! It even has an AI buddy Nexus
to help me make the most of my contacts and wow I did not realize I had so many! Networking level
up.

As a dedicated Obsidian user in the past, my encounter with Mesh eliminated the need for anything
else. Mesh offers an extremely simple, minimalist, and user-friendly interface. Now, I can activate
my notes directly from any application on my computer, effortlessly translating my thoughts into
writing.

Moreover, thanks to artificial intelligence integration, I have the freedom to intervene in my notes
in any desired direction, and I can receive assistance in discovering the relationships between the
notes afterward. This experience is truly astounding, and in my view, I no longer need anything
else.

@MeshHQ is by far one of the best tools that I’ve used to not just manage but Grow relationships.
It’s a complete no brainer for connecting with those whom you care about!

You know you have a good app when you get an annual subscription reminder and you are excited to pay
it because of the value that it brings to you. I thought the cost was a bit high last year when
signing up but this year, I’ve been really impressed with the speed of development and adding new
features that are impactful.

I’m also a big fan of their support. I’ve always gotten thoughtful responses. If you want to be more
intentional with your relationships, I recommend checking out Mesh!

This is the LAST time I ever deal with cards. @MeshHQ just made connecting at conference a 💯 times
easier.

Get their cards, scan it, throw it. You’ll have all their info and it merges with your Instagram,
LinkedIn, iOS cards, WhatsApp... Thanks @Achariam & @zmh! Changed the life of an entrepreneur.

There’s a meme in startupland that building a personal CRM company is a dead end.

But I think @MeshHQ have solved it. 6 weeks into using it, with some time investment getting all my
contacts set up, and it’s helping me feel more connected every day.

I like the user experience, seamless reminders that show up in the right time and how it keeps
getting more and more useful in business contacts. CRM done well and with little need to organize
everything, you just keep adding.

## Trusted by people who
## value relationships

LOVE THIS APP. Such a powerful tool and helps me both personally and professionally manage
relationships, check in with colleagues/friends, and stay updated on what people in my contacts are
up to. Would be much harder to do all of this without this app.

Ok, absolutely love this because why was I trying to build a similar solution for myself using
Trello and Notion and it was just not giving. Mesh however does GIVE! It even has an AI buddy Nexus
to help me make the most of my contacts and wow I did not realize I had so many! Networking level
up.

As a dedicated Obsidian user in the past, my encounter with Mesh eliminated the need for anything
else. Mesh offers an extremely simple, minimalist, and user-friendly interface. Now, I can activate
my notes directly from any application on my computer, effortlessly translating my thoughts into
writing.

Moreover, thanks to artificial intelligence integration, I have the freedom to intervene in my notes
in any desired direction, and I can receive assistance in discovering the relationships between the
notes afterward. This experience is truly astounding, and in my view, I no longer need anything
else.

@MeshHQ is by far one of the best tools that I’ve used to not just manage but Grow relationships.
It’s a complete no brainer for connecting with those whom you care about!

You know you have a good app when you get an annual subscription reminder and you are excited to pay
it because of the value that it brings to you. I thought the cost was a bit high last year when
signing up but this year, I’ve been really impressed with the speed of development and adding new
features that are impactful.

I’m also a big fan of their support. I’ve always gotten thoughtful responses. If you want to be more
intentional with your relationships, I recommend checking out Mesh!

This is the LAST time I ever deal with cards. @MeshHQ just made connecting at conference a 💯 times
easier.

Get their cards, scan it, throw it. You’ll have all their info and it merges with your Instagram,
LinkedIn, iOS cards, WhatsApp... Thanks @Achariam & @zmh! Changed the life of an entrepreneur.

There’s a meme in startupland that building a personal CRM company is a dead end.

But I think @MeshHQ have solved it. 6 weeks into using it, with some time investment getting all my
contacts set up, and it’s helping me feel more connected every day.

I like the user experience, seamless reminders that show up in the right time and how it keeps
getting more and more useful in business contacts. CRM done well and with little need to organize
everything, you just keep adding.

# Ion-Exchange Resin & Activated Carbon Distributor

M.L. Ball Company, Inc. is proud to be a leading distributor of ion-exchange resin filters and
activated carbon filter cartridges, as well as a premier provider of industrial water treatment and
power equipment to businesses and governmental entities worldwide. Let us provide the water
treatment solution that’s ideal for your business, tailored for quality.

[Learn More][20]

[over 50 years][over 50 years]
We have extreme knowledge and experience, earned through years of work in the industry. Our company
currently stands as an authority on the subject of [activated carbon][21].
[dura cube][dura cube]
Our business was founded in 1967. With more than 50 years behind us, we’re a trusted supplier to
businesses and governmental entities worldwide.
[owqa][owqa]
We proudly offer a broad selection of quality products and filter materials, both from leading brand
names, as well as proprietary proven products of our own design.
[thumbs up][thumbs up]
We’re members of the Water Quality Association (WQA) and certified with NSF International.
[family owned and operated][family owned and operated]
Our business is headquartered in Atlanta, GA, with regional offices in Birmingham, AL, Baltimore,
MD, Raleigh, NC and Houston, TX, as well as Trinidad and Tobago.

## Leading Water Treatment Solutions for Industrial and Power Markets

[sign][sign]Water treatment is critical for so many reasons, across a broad range of industrial
applications. At M.L. Ball Company, Inc., we would know—we’re the authority on a broad range of
treatment and purification solutions, including [reverse osmosis][22] (RO) systems, ion exchange
resins, filter media products and much, much more, including demineralizers and deaerators. Over the
past 50 years, we’ve become a leading name in water treatment for power.

Our scope of successful, proven products is backed by an experienced engineering and sales staff
with the knowledge to set us apart. We don’t just source filter media and water treatment products
from the world’s top OEMs—we also take the time to consult with and educate our customers. Our
mission is improving the efficiency, effectiveness and integrity of your water treatment solutions.

Our diverse experience with all types of commercial, industrial and municipal customers allows us to
operate at any scale. We even offer water system consulting and custom carbon filter manufacturing
to ensure maximum results from your specific application. Whether it’s finding the right filter
media for clean paper pulping or helping you settle on the right water treatment for steam, count on
M.L. Ball Company, Inc. to lead the way.

## Meeting Your Water Quality Needs

If you have questions about water purification systems, filter media or general water treatment,
waste no time in contacting M.L. Ball Company, Inc. today. We’re ready to serve you.

[Contact Us][23]

# Ion-Exchange Resin & Activated Carbon Distributor

M.L. Ball Company, Inc. is proud to be a leading distributor of ion-exchange resin filters and
activated carbon filter cartridges, as well as a premier provider of industrial water treatment and
power equipment to businesses and governmental entities worldwide. Let us provide the water
treatment solution that’s ideal for your business, tailored for quality.

[Learn More][20]

[over 50 years][over 50 years]
We have extreme knowledge and experience, earned through years of work in the industry. Our company
currently stands as an authority on the subject of [activated carbon][21].
[dura cube][dura cube]
Our business was founded in 1967. With more than 50 years behind us, we’re a trusted supplier to
businesses and governmental entities worldwide.
[owqa][owqa]
We proudly offer a broad selection of quality products and filter materials, both from leading brand
names, as well as proprietary proven products of our own design.
[thumbs up][thumbs up]
We’re members of the Water Quality Association (WQA) and certified with NSF International.
[family owned and operated][family owned and operated]
Our business is headquartered in Atlanta, GA, with regional offices in Birmingham, AL, Baltimore,
MD, Raleigh, NC and Houston, TX, as well as Trinidad and Tobago.

## Leading Water Treatment Solutions for Industrial and Power Markets

[sign][sign]Water treatment is critical for so many reasons, across a broad range of industrial
applications. At M.L. Ball Company, Inc., we would know—we’re the authority on a broad range of
treatment and purification solutions, including [reverse osmosis][22] (RO) systems, ion exchange
resins, filter media products and much, much more, including demineralizers and deaerators. Over the
past 50 years, we’ve become a leading name in water treatment for power.

Our scope of successful, proven products is backed by an experienced engineering and sales staff
with the knowledge to set us apart. We don’t just source filter media and water treatment products
from the world’s top OEMs—we also take the time to consult with and educate our customers. Our
mission is improving the efficiency, effectiveness and integrity of your water treatment solutions.

Our diverse experience with all types of commercial, industrial and municipal customers allows us to
operate at any scale. We even offer water system consulting and custom carbon filter manufacturing
to ensure maximum results from your specific application. Whether it’s finding the right filter
media for clean paper pulping or helping you settle on the right water treatment for steam, count on
M.L. Ball Company, Inc. to lead the way.

## Meeting Your Water Quality Needs

If you have questions about water purification systems, filter media or general water treatment,
waste no time in contacting M.L. Ball Company, Inc. today. We’re ready to serve you.

[Contact Us][23]

### Our Latest guide:San Francisco

San Francisco is often romanticized for its bridges, hills, and postcard views, but what makes the
city feel so memorable is the deeply local culture woven into everyday life. Beneath the iconic
landmarks is a city shaped by generations of immigrants, artists, musicians, activists, and
independent businesses that continue to give each neighborhood its own distinct identity. Within
just seven square miles, you’ll find historic corner cafes, old bookstores, live music drifting out
of bars, tiny family-run restaurants, and communities that still feel deeply connected to the
rhythms of daily life.

***Journal.***
* ## 1 | Conversation with: Tea at Shiloh
  
  Whether you seek solace in the many cozy corners in the Teahouse or engage in conversations in the
  Annex, Tea at Shiloh provides a haven of warmth, serenity — and endless herbal teas.
  
  [**Read more ↗**][33]
  
  [Two girls sitting at a table drinking tea]
* ## 2 | Our favorite hotels across Japan
  
  You’ll find everything from design-forward stays in Tokyo to quiet machiya inns in Kyoto, and
  small, welcoming hotels in Kanazawa and beyond. Each one has been chosen for its sense of
  character, thoughtful details, and connection to the neighborhood it’s in.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][34]
  
  [Cobblestone pathway in Magome Town, Japan]
* ## 3 | The Best Green Teahouses in Central Tokyo
  
  An authentic teahouse experience is a must for anyone visiting Japan. Sipping matcha on a tatami
  mat while overlooking a serene pond - it’s such a special zen-like vibe that can only be
  experienced in Japan.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][35]
  
  [Tray of tea and treat on a table overlooking a pond]
* ## 4 | An offbeat guide to Beverly Hills
  
  Nestled amidst the palm-lined boulevards and mansions of Beverly Hills lies a quieter, more down
  to earth side to this illustrious city—a side often overlooked by the glitz and glamour of its
  more renowned attractions like Rodeo Drive and celebrity sighting tours.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][36]
  
  [Beverly Hills Hotel main entrance to lobby]

  As you prepare to immerse yourself in the Land of the Rising Sun, let this guide be your
  companion. With a blend of practical insights that will save you time, and cultural awareness that
  show respect for all the nuances that define Japanese society.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][37]

#### **iI. *North Beach, San Francisco California***

### Our Latest guide:San Francisco

San Francisco is often romanticized for its bridges, hills, and postcard views, but what makes the
city feel so memorable is the deeply local culture woven into everyday life. Beneath the iconic
landmarks is a city shaped by generations of immigrants, artists, musicians, activists, and
independent businesses that continue to give each neighborhood its own distinct identity. Within
just seven square miles, you’ll find historic corner cafes, old bookstores, live music drifting out
of bars, tiny family-run restaurants, and communities that still feel deeply connected to the
rhythms of daily life.

#### [shop guide here ↗][32]

#### **iII. *san francisco City Guide***

***Journal.***
* ## 1 | Conversation with: Tea at Shiloh
  
  Whether you seek solace in the many cozy corners in the Teahouse or engage in conversations in the
  Annex, Tea at Shiloh provides a haven of warmth, serenity — and endless herbal teas.
  
  [**Read more ↗**][33]
  
  [Two girls sitting at a table drinking tea]
* ## 2 | Our favorite hotels across Japan
  
  You’ll find everything from design-forward stays in Tokyo to quiet machiya inns in Kyoto, and
  small, welcoming hotels in Kanazawa and beyond. Each one has been chosen for its sense of
  character, thoughtful details, and connection to the neighborhood it’s in.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][34]
  
  [Cobblestone pathway in Magome Town, Japan]
* ## 3 | The Best Green Teahouses in Central Tokyo
  
  An authentic teahouse experience is a must for anyone visiting Japan. Sipping matcha on a tatami
  mat while overlooking a serene pond - it’s such a special zen-like vibe that can only be
  experienced in Japan.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][35]
  
  [Tray of tea and treat on a table overlooking a pond]
* ## 4 | An offbeat guide to Beverly Hills
  
  Nestled amidst the palm-lined boulevards and mansions of Beverly Hills lies a quieter, more down
  to earth side to this illustrious city—a side often overlooked by the glitz and glamour of its
  more renowned attractions like Rodeo Drive and celebrity sighting tours.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][36]
  
  [Beverly Hills Hotel main entrance to lobby]
* ## 5 | First-timer travel advice to Japan
  
  As you prepare to immerse yourself in the Land of the Rising Sun, let this guide be your
  companion. With a blend of practical insights that will save you time, and cultural awareness that
  show respect for all the nuances that define Japanese society.
  
  [**Read More ↗**][37]
  
  [Two Japanese people bowing to each other with respect]

## How To Play

#### Powerball®

Powerball® costs $2 per play. In Idaho and Montana, Powerball is bundled with Power Play® for a
minimum purchase price of $3 per play.

Select five numbers between 1 and 69 for the white balls, then select one number between 1 and 26
for the red Powerball.

Choose your numbers on a play slip or let the lottery terminal randomly pick your numbers.

Drawings are held every Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday at 10:59 pm ET at the Florida Lottery draw
studio in Tallahasee. To watch the drawings, click [HERE][29].

The Powerball jackpot grows until it is won. Players win a prize by matching one of the 9 ways to
win. The jackpot is won by matching all five white balls in any order and the red Powerball.

Jackpot winners may choose to receive their prize as an annuity, paid in 30 graduated payments over
29 years, or a lump-sum payment. Both advertised prize options are prior to federal and
jurisdictional taxes.

#### Power Play® and Double Play®

Powerball offers two optional add-on features: Power Play® and Double Play®

For an additional $1 per play, Power Play multiplies non-jackpot prizes by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X or 10X.
The Match 5 + Power Play prize is always $2 million. The 10X multiplier is available only when the
advertised jackpot is $150 million or less.

For an additional $1 per play, Double Play gives players another chance to win a separate drawing
using the same numbers played in the Powerball drawing. Double Play features a top cash prize of $10
million and eight additional cash prizes. Double Play drawings are held after each Powerball drawing
and are available in participating jurisdictions

## Where To Play

Powerball is currently sold in 45 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and the U.S.
Virgin Islands. Beginning July 21, 2026, Powerball ticket sales will expand to the United Kingdom.

Powerball drawings are held every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 10:59 p.m. ET.

Sales cut-off times vary by one to two hours before the drawing, depending on the selling
jurisdiction.

# **Sai Baba Minerals**

India's largest producer of ultrafine industrial minerals and specialty chemicals, we mine, process,
and sell our products globally offering varied innovative product range.
Sai Baba Minerals is a pioneer in the field of industrial minerals in India, introducing the
organized concept of micronization and offering a wide portfolio of micronized and sub micronized
minerals. As a trusted industrial minerals exporter, we supply premium quality Potash, Sodium,
quartz, feldspar, silica sand, China Clay, Ball Clay, Bentonite, calsite, calcium carbonate and
specialty minerals to diverse industries worldwide.
In recent years, Sai Baba Minerals has expanded into specialty chemicals and performance additives,
catering to niche segments and advanced formulations. With superior technology and innovation, we
deliver high value functional solutions that enhance product performance across multiple
applications.
Backed by a dedicated R&D and Product Application Centre, we continuously innovate to provide
customized mineral solutions. Our commitment to quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction
makes us a preferred partner for industries seeking industrial minerals, specialty chemicals, and
performance additives in India and global markets.

## EXCELLENCE IN TECHNOLOGY AND SERVICE

SACMI is an international group, world leader in the supply of advanced technologies for the
Ceramics, Plastics, Food & Beverage, Metals, Packaging and Advanced Materials sectors, thanks to the
application of innovative technologies, its strong positioning on the world markets, and its
continuous search for high quality standards and customer service. 
Continuous investments in Research & Development - 234 million euro in the last 3 years alone -
allow SACMI to offer the market the best state of the art technologies, working alongside the
customer to develop increasingly efficient, competitive and sustainable products and processes.

## SACMI ACADEMY
## The Machine University

An open space at the heart of the SACMI production environment for sharing skills, work tools and
values.
Professional and human values, and over a century of technological expertise combine to produce some
of the very best professionals to be found in today’s manufacturing sector. 
In Italy and abroad.

###  

## SACMI GROUP

The SACMI Group operates globally with over 70 production, distribution and service companies
operating in 25 countries. The SACMI brand and logo are recognised and protected in over 100
countries worldwide. Through its own brands and thanks to the companies of its Global Network,
active in the five continents, SACMI distributes its products and services all over the world,
always putting customer satisfaction first.

## INNOVATION SINCE 1919

Technological innovation and knowledge represent a considerable asset for SACMI: the distinctive
sign with which the Group operates, in the various sectors of activity, on international markets.
SACMI dedicates great energy and capital to the R&D sector, in order to promote new technological
applications for the improvement and evolution of its range of products.
 

## SUSTAINABILITY

Generating sustainable innovation is the challenge that SACMI has faced by becoming a protagonist of
the circular economy, with solutions aimed at containing the consumption of raw materials and
energy, new technologies and prototypes made possible by the extensive knowledge of materials and
processes. Furthermore, the investments made in recent years have made it possible to greatly reduce
the environmental impact of production activities, containing emissions into the atmosphere,
reducing water consumption and optimizing the waste management cycle.

the circular economy, with solutions aimed at containing the consumption of raw materials and
energy, new technologies and prototypes made possible by the extensive knowledge of materials and
processes. Furthermore, the investments made in recent years have made it possible to greatly reduce
the environmental impact of production activities, containing emissions into the atmosphere,
reducing water consumption and optimizing the waste management cycle.

SACMI is an international group, world leader in the supply of advanced technologies for the
Ceramics, Plastics, Food & Beverage, Metals, Packaging and Advanced Materials sectors, thanks to the

continuous search for high quality standards and customer service. 
Continuous investments in Research & Development - 234 million euro in the last 3 years alone -
allow SACMI to offer the market the best state of the art technologies, working alongside the
customer to develop increasingly efficient, competitive and sustainable products and processes.

# Quality Minerals, Since 2007.

Somnath Group started in 2007. We supply kaolin clay, silica sand, ball clay, and other minerals to
the ceramics, tiles, glass, and construction industries. We are based in the mineral-rich area of
Kutch, Gujarat, India. From mining to refining and quality checking, we make sure our products are
reliable and of good quality.
* Over 19 years of experience in the industry
* Highest quality assurance
* Green Future & environmental commitment
* Trusted supplier in India and beyond

About us

# Quality Minerals, Since 2007.

Somnath Group started in 2007. We supply kaolin clay, silica sand, ball clay, and other minerals to
the ceramics, tiles, glass, and construction industries. We are based in the mineral-rich area of
Kutch, Gujarat, India. From mining to refining and quality checking, we make sure our products are
reliable and of good quality.
* Over 19 years of experience in the industry
* Highest quality assurance
* Green Future & environmental commitment
* Trusted supplier in India and beyond
